name: Iso Chiaki
source:
A novice freelance reporter who is scared of talking to people. [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] hires her to help write articles for the next issue of [I]Four Star General Gossip[/I].

Chiaki's tendecy to become flustered is famous among her freelance writer colleagues. Once, she conducted an hour-long interview during which she only managed to ask her interview subject's name — yet another chapter in "The Legend of Hopelessly Flustered Chiaki."

[Edited from in-game TIPS]
